title: IsingFormer: Augmenting Parallel Tempering With Learned Proposals
abstract: arXiv:2509.23043v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative models have been extensively used to accelerate MCMC mixing for sampling and optimization, but their effective integration with standard MCMC remains an open question. Here, we introduce a global proposal move in which finite-temperature configurations from an external generator are used as proposals within Parallel Tempering (PT). We examine a specific generator, IsingFormer, a Transformer trained on long-run MCMC configurations intended to approximate equilibrium distributions, and call the resulting framework Transformer-Augmented Parallel Tempering (TAPT). The IsingFormer exhibits two useful capabilities: interpolation to untrained $\beta$ values and conditional completion under clamped settings absent from training. translated_title: IsingFormer：利用学习到的提议增强并行回火
translated_abstract: 生成模型已被广泛用于加速MCMC混合以进行采样和优化，但它们与标准MCMC的有效集成仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在此，我们引入了一种全局提议移动，其中来自外部生成器的有限温度配置被用作并行回火（PT）中的提议。我们研究了一种特定的生成器IsingFormer，它是一个在长时间运行的MCMC配置上训练的Transformer，旨在近似平衡分布，并将由此产生的框架称为Transformer增强并行回火（TAPT）。IsingFormer展现出两个有用的能力：对未训练的β值进行插值，以及在训练中未出现的固定设置下进行条件补全。在3D自旋玻璃实例上，TAPT在更少的蒙特卡洛扫描中达到了比标准PT显著更低的残余能量。在整数分解问题上，我们展示了结构化问题编码如何…
tldr: 本文提出TAPT框架，将基于Transformer的生成器IsingFormer学到的全局提议集成到并行回火中，在3D自旋玻璃问题上以更少的蒙特卡洛扫描获得显著更低的残余能量，并展现出对未训练温度的插值和条件补全能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TAPT, a framework integrating Transformer-learned global proposals from the IsingFormer generator into Parallel Tempering, achieving substantially lower residual energies on 3D spin-glass instances with fewer Monte Carlo sweeps, along with interpolation to untrained temperatures and conditional completion capabilities.
